reason: On my college budget I would definitely use the 7-day trial to vent, but I'd cancel right away because paying a recurring monthly fee for a chatbot isn't justifiable.
objection: $9.99 a month is way too steep for what might just turn out to be a glorified ChatGPT wrapper.
would_change_my_mind: A heavily discounted student plan under $3 a month or a functional permanent free tier.
